messages:
Evan: opened PR #4789 — small docs cleanup around function/tool calling and structured output. Scope: fix two broken anchors, recommend a single call envelope shape, add a tiny "coercion/fallback" recipe and update SDK samples (py & ts). PTAL :wave:

Priya: can you list the exact broken anchors so I can patch the redirects?

Evan: yep: /docs/old-function-calls.md#response-shapes and /docs/schema-recipes.md#optional-lists — both 404s after earlier reorg. PR adds redirect entries and updates links across the examples. Also standardizes the envelope to {"action": "name", "args": {...}} which avoids collisions with models that emit top-level keys.

Sam: good call on the envelope. Are we changing all examples inline or adding a migration paragraph?

Evan: both — inline examples updated and a short paragraph in the function-calling guide explaining the reason and showing a tiny migration snippet.

Alin: I'll add the redirect rules and trigger the search reindex. Also will drop a one-line entry in CHANGELOG: "Docs: canonical call envelope + anchor redirects."

Priya: SDK snippets — what helpers do I need to update in the docs?

Evan: python: show `structured_output.make_envelope(action, args)` and `structured_output.parse_and_coerce(resp, schema)`; ts: show `callUtils.formatEnvelope()` and `callUtils.normalizeArgs()`. I put minimal runnable examples in the PR so docs-tests can assert normalized outputs.

Sam: we should include a short parse-fallback recipe: 1) validate with JSON Schema; 2) coerce obvious mismatches (string -> array, single item -> [item]); 3) fallback to safe default and emit a telemetry event. Include tiny code samples showing each.

Priya: added a note to the PR that the JSON Schema example should prefer explicit types (array vs union) to reduce ambiguity. Also added one example schema for a todo-add call.

Evan: example (python) I put in PR comments:
```
# coerce operands into list
from redwood.structured_output import parse_and_coerce
raw = '{"action":"add","args":{"items":"1,2"}}'
env = parse_and_coerce(raw, schema)
# env['args']['items'] == [1,2]
```

Sam: please add a test in docs-tests that mocks: valid envelope, stringified list, null list, and wrapped result. Keep tests small and focused.

Alin: link-checker ran in CI and flagged one remaining reference to the old anchor inside an archived file. I can update that too.

docs-bot: CI: build-docs ✅, link-checker ✅, docs-tests -> 1 failing (missing tests from Sam).

Evan: will wait for tests, then re-request reviews. After approvals I'll merge and ask merge-bot to schedule the docs deploy. Thanks all! :rocket:
